title: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines for Large Batch Cooking
h1: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines for Large Batch Cooking
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for sous vide machines for large batch cooking, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at sous vide machines for large batch cooking using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Anova Precision Cooker 3.0, 1100W WiFi Sous Vide
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W heating element, 8L/min flow rate, the highest in this list, Clamps to stockpots and coolers up to 8 gallons.
strengths: Highest flow rate of any circulator here, the single most important spec for large-volume evenness
1100W recovers fastest after adding 15-plus pounds of cold protein at once
8-gallon clamp range accommodates large coolers, not just standard stockpots
Remote WiFi monitoring is genuinely useful for multi-hour large batch cooks
limitations: Still benefits from a second unit for containers over 10 gallons, like any single circulator
Clamp mechanism, while robust, is bulkier to store than compact models
features: 8L/min flow rate, the highest in this list
Clamps to stockpots and coolers up to 8 gallons
WiFi app for monitoring long, large cooks remotely

products.name: KitchenBoss Sous Vide Cooker G321, 1100W
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W brushless DC motor, Adjustable clamp for large stockpots, Built-in TFT display with recipe presets.
strengths: 1100W recovery power at a price low enough to justify buying a second unit for dual-circulator setups
Built-in display works independently, useful when running two units without needing two app connections
Quiet motor is a real benefit over multi-hour large-batch cooks
limitations: Smaller brand with less long-term large-batch reliability data than Anova
No app for coordinating settings between two units remotely
Fewer total ratings than the established market leaders
features: Built-in TFT display with recipe presets
Ultra-quiet operation for long cook sessions

products.name: Monoprice Strata Home Sous Vide Immersion Cooker, 1100W
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W brushless motor, Adjustable clamp, Touch control interface.
strengths: 1100W at the lowest price of any circulator in this list, useful as an affordable backup or second unit
Simple controls mean less to configure when running multiple circulators at once
IPX7 rating holds up fine for long cooks in a cooler or large stockpot
limitations: Smaller brand with the least established long-term reliability track record here
No app or remote monitoring features
Build quality feedback is more mixed than the other picks in this list

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
